# Harness

Harness Core CD APIs for managing pipelines, executions, services, environments, infrastructure, input sets, triggers, and templates.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/harness/.

## Actions

- **List Environments** (read-only): List one page of environments in a Harness project, optionally filtered by identifiers or search text.
- **List Organizations** (read-only): List one page of Harness organizations accessible to the connected account, optionally filtered by identifier or search text.
- **List Pipeline Executions** (read-only): List one page of pipeline executions in a Harness project, optionally filtered by pipeline, status, search text, or current-user ownership.
- **List Pipelines** (read-only): List one page of pipelines in a Harness project, optionally filtered by search text or Git branch.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List one page of Harness projects accessible to the connected account, optionally within an organization or filtered by module and search…
- **List Services** (read-only): List one page of services in a Harness project, optionally filtered by identifiers, deployment type, tags, storage, GitOps state, or…
- **List Templates** (read-only): List one page of account-scoped Harness templates, optionally filtered by template state, entity or child type, identifier, name,…
